# Errors

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from the error registry; do not edit. -->

Every error answer is `{code, message, field?, committed, correlation_id}`. `retry`
says what a client does: `no` (permanent: do not resend the same request), `stop`
(a credential problem: stop sending and alert), `later` (retry with back-off,
honouring `Retry-After`). The CLI exits with the code's exit status when the error
ends a command. HTTP 0 marks a client-only code.

| Code | HTTP | Retry | CLI exit | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `E_INVALID` | 400 | no | 3 | fix the named field |
| `E_SCHEMA_VERSION` | 400 | no | 3 | use a client that matches the server's schema version |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | 401 | stop | 3 | check the token |
| `E_FORBIDDEN` | 403 | stop | 3 | check the token's scope or the user's role |
| `E_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | no | 3 | check the reference |
| `E_REVISION_CONFLICT` | 409 | no | 3 | send the correction as a new revision |
| `E_STALE_REVISION` | 409 | no | 3 | nothing to do: a newer revision exists |
| `E_PRECONDITION_FAILED` | 412 | no | 3 | reload, then apply your change again |
| `E_RETRY_INPUTS_DIFFER` | 409 | no | 3 | declare another slot for different inputs |
| `E_EXPIRED` | 410 | no | 3 | the regression is past retention |
| `E_REPLAY_EXPIRED` | 410 | no | 3 | the record is older than the deduplication horizon |
| `E_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | no | 3 | split the batch or reduce the record |
| `E_UNPROCESSABLE` | 422 | no | 3 | fix the record |
| `E_NOT_SUPPORTED` | 400 | no | 3 | the feature is not available in this version |
| `E_MIXED_CREDENTIALS` | 400 | no | 3 | send exactly one credential |
| `E_RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | later | 4 | wait and retry (Retry-After) |
| `E_INTERNAL` | 500 | later | 5 | report it with the correlation ID |
| `E_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | later | 4 | wait and retry |
| `E_STORAGE_FULL` | 507 | later | 4 | free disk space on the server |
| `E_INSECURE_URL` | 0 | no | 2 | use an https:// server URL |
